## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the problem and what changes for users or contributors.

## Validation

List commands actually run, results and environment. Explicitly mark tests not run.

## Decisions, compatibility and limitations

Link the issue, ADR or journal entry. Explain image/kernel compatibility impacts.

## Contribution checks

- [ ] I reviewed the change and have the right to contribute it under GPL-2.0-only.
- [ ] Relevant documentation, history and changelog are updated.
- [ ] No credentials, real agent memories or private vulnerability details are included.
- [ ] Material AI assistance and human review are summarized below, if applicable.
